topic: Trying Samples at a Warehouse Store

script.title: AT THE WAREHOUSE CLUB
script.title_quote: You sold me on the soup
script.story_hook: A shopper tries samples and asks about membership.
script.intro_zh: 一位顧客在量販店試吃,顺便詢問會員卡。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back! Today, free samples at a big warehouse store.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來!今天來聽量販店免費試吃的完整對話。
script.outro: You made it through sixty lines! Membership talk feels easy now.
script.outro_zh: 你聽完了六十句!會員對話現在變得很簡單。
script.practice_intro_en: In chapter three, repeat every line out loud.
script.practice_intro_zh: 第三章請大聲跟讀每一個句子。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with short dark brown hair, wearing a gray zip hoodie, blue jeans and white sneakers, tall and slim build, carrying a small backpack
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman with shoulder-length curly black hair, wearing a red store vest over a white shirt, black pants and comfortable flat shoes, stocky friendly build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, are these samples free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi ɑr ðiz ˈsæmpəls friː/
dialogue.zh: 打擾一下,這些試吃是免費的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They're free for members, sir.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz fri fər ˈmɛmbərz sər/
dialogue.zh: 會員可以免費試吃,先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Members? I don't have a card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛmbərz aɪ doʊnt hæv ə kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 會員?我沒有卡耶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem — you can join today.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈprɑbləm ju kən ˈdʒɔɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題,您今天就能加入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the card expensive?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə kɑrd ɪkˈspɛnsɪv/
dialogue.zh: 會員卡很貴嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's sixty a year, plus a guest card.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈsɪksti ə jɪr plʌs ə ɡɛst kɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 一年六十元,還附贈一張來賓卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty? Wow. Okay, what do I get?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪksti waʊ oʊˈkeɪ wʌt du aɪ ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 六十?哇。好,我能得到什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Big discounts and free samples like this.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪɡ ˈdɪskaʊnts ænd fri ˈsæmpəls laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 大幅折扣,還有像這樣的免費試吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. Can my wife use it too?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛr ɪˈnʌf kən maɪ waɪf juz ɪt tuː/
dialogue.zh: 有道理。我太太也能一起用嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure — one card covers your whole house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌn kɑrd ˈkʌvərz jɔr hoʊl haʊs/
dialogue.zh: 當然,一張卡涵蓋您全家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. So what's on the table today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt soʊ wʌts ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。那今天試吃桌上有什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Chicken soup, granola, and cheese bites.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʃɪkən sup ɡrəˈnoʊlə ænd tʃiz baɪts/
dialogue.zh: 雞肉湯、格蘭諾拉麥片,還有起司小點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soup sounds good. May I try it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sup saʊndz ɡʊd me aɪ traɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 雞肉湯聽起來不錯,我可以試試嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go — careful, it's hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr jə ɡoʊ ˈkɛrfəl ɪts hɑt/
dialogue.zh: 給您,小心,很燙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mmm, that's rich. Is it low in salt?
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌm ðæts rɪtʃ ɪz ɪt loʊ ɪn sɔlt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯,味道好濃。鈉含量低嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fairly — check the box by the stand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪrli tʃɛk ðə bɑks baɪ ðə stænd/
dialogue.zh: 還算低,請看看試吃架旁邊的標示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow — is this the forty-eight can case?
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈfɔrti ˈeɪt kæn keɪs/
dialogue.zh: 哇,這是四十八罐裝的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — the price per can is great.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə praɪs pər kæn ɪz ɡreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對,每罐的單價很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But I live alone. That's too much food.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt aɪ lɪv əˈloʊn ðæts tuː mʌtʃ fud/
dialogue.zh: 可是我一個人住,這太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We hear that a lot — try the small size.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hɪr ðæt ə lɑt traɪ ðə smɔl saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們常聽人這樣說,試試小包裝吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there one with twelve cans?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr wʌn wɪθ twɛlv kænz/
dialogue.zh: 有十二罐裝的嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelves are upstairs, next to the rice.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlvz ɑr ˌʌpˈstɛrz nɛkst tə ðə raɪs/
dialogue.zh: 十二罐裝在樓上,就在米旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good. Hey, what's that smell over there?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd heɪ wʌts ðæt smɛl ˈoʊvər ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 好。嘿,那邊是什麼香味?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New rotation — bacon crackers today.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˌroʊˈteɪʃən ˈbeɪkən ˈkrækərz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 試吃今天換新項目,培根餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crackers? I can't say no to those.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrækərz aɪ kænt seɪ noʊ tə ðoz/
dialogue.zh: 餅乾?那個我可沒辦法拒絕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the crackers — fresh from the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈkrækərz frɛʃ frʌm ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 來試試餅乾,剛從後面拿出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay… oh no, I spilled a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ɑʊ noʊ aɪ ˈspɪld ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 好……噢不,我灑了一點出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's fine, I'll wipe it right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts faɪn aɪl waɪp ɪt raɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係,我馬上擦乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry about that! Is this here every day?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri əˈbaʊt ðæt ɪz ðɪs hɪr ˈɛvri deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 真抱歉!這個試吃每天都有嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weekends only — weekdays have fewer stands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌɛndz ˈoʊnli ˈwikˌdeɪz hæv ˈfjuːər stændz/
dialogue.zh: 只有週末,平日試吃攤少一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see. Are the crackers on sale?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɑr ðə ˈkrækərz ɑn seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 了解。那培根餅乾有特價嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not today, but coupons came out.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt təˈdeɪ bʌt ˈkupɑnz keɪm ˈaʊt/
dialogue.zh: 今天沒有,不過剛出折價券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coupons? Where do I find them?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkupɑnz wɛr du aɪ faɪnd ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 折價券?要在哪裡找?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the big app, or at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈɡræn æp ɔr æt ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在手機App裡,或是在門口領。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have the app. Um, one more question.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ði æp ʌm wʌn mɔr ˈkwɛstʃən/
dialogue.zh: 我有那個App。嗯,再多問一個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask away — the line's short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr æsk əˈweɪ ðə laɪnz ʃɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 請說吧,現在排隊的人不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is membership worth it for one person?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈmɛmbərʃɪp wərθ ɪt fər wʌn ˈpərsən/
dialogue.zh: 一個人來的話,辦會員值得嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you shop twice a month, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju ʃɑp twaɪs ə mʌnθ jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 如果您一個月來買兩次,就很划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, my grocery bill is small.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm maɪ ˈɡroʊsəri bɪl ɪz smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 嗯,我買菜花得不多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then share a box with a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ʃɛr ə bɑks wɪð ə frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 那您可以跟朋友分一盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's smart. My neighbor loves soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts smɑrt maɪ ˈneɪbər lʌvz sup/
dialogue.zh: 好主意,我鄰居最愛喝湯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly — split forty-eight, no waste.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli splɪt ˈfɔrti eɪt noʊ weɪst/
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣,四十八罐兩人分,不浪費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, you sold me on the soup.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ju soʊld mi ɑn ðə sup/
dialogue.zh: 好吧,雞肉湯我就買單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice! First-timers get a free tote.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs fərst ˈtaɪmərz ɡɛt ə fri toʊt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了!第一次辦會員送購物袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A tote? What's in it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə toʊt wʌts ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 購物袋?裡面有什麼?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the bag — you fill it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə bæɡ ju fɪl ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 就是空袋子,自己慢慢裝滿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! Alright, sign me up for one.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɔlˈraɪt saɪn mi ʌp fər wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哈!好啦,幫我辦一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great — I need your name and phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪ nid jɔr neɪm ænd foʊn/
dialogue.zh: 好,請給我您的名字和電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here's my ID. How long does it take?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪrz maɪ ˌaɪˈdi haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ɪt teɪk/
dialogue.zh: 這是我的證件,要辦多久?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two minutes… um, the printer's jammed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ˈmɪnɪts ʌm ðə ˈprɪntərz dʒæmd/
dialogue.zh: 兩分鐘……嗯,印表機卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, is that a problem?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑʊ noʊ ɪz ðæt ə ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 噢不,這會影響嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now — I'll print your card early.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ aɪl prɪnt jɔr kɑrd ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 不影響,我提前幫您印好卡片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you. Can I start right away?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju kən aɪ stɑrt raɪt əˈweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝,我馬上就能用嗎?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the soup coupon is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə sup ˈkupɑn ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 可以,雞肉湯折價券也給您。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Where's the checkout line?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpərfɪkt wɛrz ðə ˈtʃɛkaʊt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了,結帳隊伍在哪裡?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right behind me — watch your cart.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd mi wɑtʃ jɔr kɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 就在我後面,小心您的推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will do. Thanks for all your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du θæŋks fɔr ɔl jɔr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 知道了,謝謝您所有的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Try the cheese bites!
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒər traɪ ðə tʃiz baɪts/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣,去試試起司小點吧!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I definitely will. Have a good shift.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈdɛfɪnətli wɪl hæv ə ɡʊd ʃɪft/
dialogue.zh: 一定會的,祝您上班順利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You too — see you next weekend!
dialogue.phonetic: /ju tuː si ju nɛkst ˈwikˌɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 您也是,下個週末見!

script.youtube_description:
60句英文聽力練習:量販店試吃與會員卡完整對話!
第一次去量販店,想試吃卻不好意思開口?擔心會員卡划不划得來?這支全英文動畫對話帶你走過整個過程:詢問試吃、年費與附卡、比較大包裝單價、灑了湯的小意外、拿折價券、跟鄰居分一盒,最後當場辦卡結帳。
你會練到:
🍲 禮貌詢問:Excuse me, are these samples free?
💳 談會員:It's sixty a year, plus a guest card.
🎟️ 找折價券:Where do I find them?
🛒 做決定:Okay, you sold me on the soup.
影片採四章結構,後半段逐句聽力加跟讀,把實用的句子唸到會自動出口。不用背單字,聽多了你就會用。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者。
喜歡的話請訂閱、按讚並開啟通知,每週新增一支沉浸式英文聽力動畫!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
"You sold me on the soup!" — one sentence that solves samples and membership in one trip. In this 60-line A2 listening animation, a first-time shopper tastes chicken soup and bacon crackers at the sample stand, asks about the yearly card fee and guest card, worries a forty-eight can case is too big, handles a small spill, finds coupons in the app, and shares a bulk box with a neighbor before signing up at the counter. Listen line by line, then repeat every sentence out loud in the shadowing chapter. No memorizing needed — just listen a lot and the phrases stick. Perfect for A2 learners who want real shopping English. Subscribe and tap the bell for a new immersive English listening animation every week!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
